problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.notes: the k=2 base case that every merge-k problem below reduces to

problems.title: Merge Sorted Array
problems.notes: merge from the back to front so you never overwrite an unread element of nums1 in place

problems.title: All Elements in Two Binary Search Trees
problems.notes: in-order traverse both BSTs into sorted lists, then merge two sorted lists — a k=2 general-tree variant

problems.title: Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix
problems.notes: treat each row as one of k sorted lists, heap-merge until the kth pop; binary search on value is the O(n log(max-min)) alternative

problems.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
problems.notes: min-heap of size k, or divide-and-conquer pairwise merge — both hit O(N log k); the pattern's namesake problem

problems.title: Smallest Range Covering Elements from K Lists
problems.notes: min-heap across all k lists while tracking the current max — classic multi-list sweep, advance whichever list is smallest

problems.title: Find the Kth Smallest Sum of a Matrix With Sorted Rows
problems.notes: k-way merge generalized: combine the running result row-by-row, keeping only the k smallest sums at each step
